title: OmniZoom
description: A lightweight zoom mod. Elevate your view with 6+ unique zoom animations, from snappy Glitch Steps to weighted Heavy Glass. Featuring sub-1x wide-angle viewing and a fully customizable tactical HUD.
body:
# OmniSight Zoom
A lightweight, tactical zoom mod for Fabric. OmniSight is built for performance and scouting, giving you high-magnification views and real-time world data without needing extra config libraries.

## 🔭 Core Features
* **Extreme Magnification:** Scroll from 0.5x (wide-angle) all the way up to **100x zoom**.
* **Entity Tracking:** Hold **Alt** while zoomed to lock onto a mob. The camera will follow the target's movement automatically.
* **Tactical HUD:** View distance (Rangefinder up to 256m), entity names, and health bars directly through the lens.
* **Precision Control:** Mouse sensitivity scales down automatically as you zoom in, so aiming at 100x isn't jittery.
* **Wide-Angle Mode:** Zoom out to 0.5x for a GoPro-style field of view.
* **Spyglass Support:** Works alongside the vanilla spyglass with custom interactions.

## 🎭 Transition Styles
Switch between 6 different animation types in the settings:
* **Glitch Step:** A snappy, digital "ticking" effect.
* **Overshoot:** Mechanical bounce that snaps into place.
* **Elastic:** Smooth, organic transition.
* **Heavy Glass:** Weighted feel for high-end lenses.
* **The Blink:** Instant cut to the zoomed view.
* **Tunnel Vision:** Darkened edges to focus on your target.

## ⌨️ Controls
| Action | Key (Default) |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Zoom** | `Z` |
| **Adjust Zoom** | `Scroll Wheel` |
| **Entity Tracking** | `Alt` (Hold while zoomed) |
| **Zoom Lock** | `V` |
| **Settings Menu** | `O` |

## 🛠️ Technical Details
* **No Dependencies:** You don't need YACL or other config libs. Just the Fabric API.
* **Performance:** Uses efficient Mixins to handle FOV and rendering, ensuring no FPS drops.
* **Hand Hiding:** Automatically hides your held item at high zoom levels for a clear view.
* **Client-Side:** Only needed on your client. Works on any server.

---
**Installation:** Drop the jar into your mods folder and ensure you have the Fabric API installed.
